chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from Ibrahim ibn Sufyan, who said:

I wrote to Abu al-Hasan al-Rida عليه السلام about a woman who performed the tawaf of hajj. When she was in the seventh circuit, she shortened it and performed tawaf through the Hijr. She then prayed the two obligatory rak'ahs, performed the sa'y, completed the tawaf of al-nisa', and then came to Mina.
So he عليه السلام wrote: "She must repeat."

key_terms.رَكْعَتَيِ ٱلْفَرِيضَةِ: the two obligatory rak'ahs prayed after tawaf
key_terms.طَوَافَ ٱلنِّسَاءِ: the tawaf of women, a required hajj rite in Shi'i law
key_terms.طَوَافَ ٱلْحَجِّ: the tawaf performed as part of hajj rites
key_terms.ٱخْتَصَرَتْ: she shortened the circuit instead of completing it fully
key_terms.ٱلْحِجْرِ: the Hijr area adjacent to the Ka'bah, passage through which affects tawaf validity

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone shortens a circuit of tawaf by passing through the Hijr during hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning tawaf during hajj when a circuit is shortened by passing through the Hijr. Imam al-Rida عليه السلام ruled that the act must be repeated, indicating the invalidity of such a deficient circuit and the necessity of completing tawaf properly.
